name: replaces a statement in place and appends a new one
existing:
root = Stack([a, b])
a = TextContent("A")
b = TextContent("B")
patch:
b = TextContent("B2")
c = TextContent("C")
root = Stack([a, b, c])
merged:
root = Stack([a, b, c])
a = TextContent("A")
b = TextContent("B2")
c = TextContent("C")

name: drops statements root no longer reaches, transitively
existing:
root = Stack([card])
card = Card([h, t])
h = CardHeader("H")
t = Table([Col("x", xs)])
xs = [1, 2]
merged:
root = Stack([card])
card = Card([h])
h = CardHeader("H")

name: deletes with null
existing:
root = Stack([a, b])
a = TextContent("A")
b = TextContent("B")

name: keeps state variables though nothing references them
object keys, members, calls and actions are no references
existing:
root = Stack([b])
b = Board([n, m])
n = Note("n", {x: 0, y: 0})
m = Note("m", {rightOf: "n", gap: 2})
x = TextContent("never")
rows = [1]
y = Button("go", @ToAssistant("hi"))
merged:
root = Stack([b])
b = Board([n, m])
n = Note("n", {x: 0, y: 0})
m = Note("m", {below: "n", gap: rows.length})
rows = [1]

name: strings with brackets, quotes and comments do not split statements
existing:
root = Stack([a, b]) // the root
a = TextContent("a ( [ { \" b = x")
# a comment
b = CodeBlock('js', 'it\'s ] }')
merged:
root = Stack([a, b]) // the root
a = TextContent("A, \n with ] inside")
b = CodeBlock('js', 'it\'s ] }')

name: a string runs on across a real line break
merged:
root = Stack([a])
a = TextContent("one
b = two")

name: a statement spans lines inside brackets
existing:
root = Stack([
  a,
  b
])
a = TextContent("A")
b = TextContent("B")
merged:
root = Stack([
  a,
  b
])
a = TextContent("A")
b = TextContent("B2")

name: a ternary continued on a line starting with ?
existing:
root = Stack([v])
v = $tab == "one"
  ? one
  : two
one = TextContent("1")
two = TextContent("2")
$tab = "one"
merged:
root = Stack([v])
v = $tab == "one"
  ? one
  : two
one = TextContent("1")
two = TextContent("II")
$tab = "one"

name: references inside object values and ternaries count
existing:
root = Stack([b])
b = Board([n])
n = Note("n", {x: 0, y: k})
k = 3
patch:
n = Note("n", {x: flag ? k : 1, y: 0})
flag = true
merged:
root = Stack([b])
b = Board([n])
n = Note("n", {x: flag ? k : 1, y: 0})
k = 3
flag = true
